caption:
No new platform. No migration. No export.

Growth Terminal is a Google Sheets add-on. Point it at the report you already export, and it ranks the twelve places growth gets stuck, tells you which one is yours, and prices it. Your data never leaves the sheet.

→ growthterminal.io
first_comment: It runs where your data already lives. Nothing to migrate.
alt_text: Point it at the sheet you already have open.
